Application release: **8ec2febe13977fc73cfa07ea1549857865b49d69**. PR #38 is merged. The exact release tree is the same tree qualified before merge.

- Main application CI **41237828167**: success, including TypeScript, unit tests, smoke/public walkthrough/equipment/cybersecurity journeys, UI and role regressions, AAS/broker contracts, build and dependency audit.
- Main ARM64 service/recovery/rollback qualification **41237828069**: success.
- Production deployment **41239702702**, attempt 2: success.
- Separate read-only production verification **41238093666**, attempt 2: success, completed **2026-10-31 20:41:19 UTC**.

Production verification checked the release identity, all **15** NVIDIA model/preview/license/provenance files byte-for-byte, and API/schema/companion compatibility. It exercised all **six** model variants at desktop and mobile viewport widths (**12** actual production rendering cases), including component selection, isolation, visual sectioning and restoration. No horizontal page overflow, failed model responses, uncaught browser errors or attempted operational API mutations were observed. Only public Demo Viewer sign-in was allowed; no production equipment, telemetry or saved views were created or changed.

Retained production evidence: artifact **13056931717**, `nvidia-production-8ec2feb`; archive SHA-256 **17167d93d3e4754cf9b50051c29a152170a58a54f4192989d028299ab04db8e5**. Original browser screenshots, twelve-case JSON, fifteen-file receipts and API runtime evidence were downloaded and checked independently.

### Deployment history preserved
The first post-promotion integrity check detected a detailed-conveyor byte mismatch and correctly failed. Read-only diagnostic run **41239849890** subsequently verified all 15 files under default-compressed and identity delivery modes: **30/30** responses matched. The cause of the first mismatch was not conclusively established. The unmodified strict deployment verification and separate browser checks then both passed. No integrity check was disabled, skipped or relaxed.

### Usage and boundaries
Open **Assets & devices → Factory models** (`/#/models`). The transfer conveyor, warehouse rack and mobile cart support automatic loading and compact/detail inspection. Authorized engineers/administrators can explicitly import a model and configure equipment/signals. Existing models and operational records remain preserved.

These are static browser references, not an enabled Omniverse/Isaac Sim physics service. Native MDL/textures are not reproduced; material adaptations and licenses remain documented. Firefox headless qualification exercised its safe non-WebGL fallback; actual Firefox WebGL rendering is not claimed. Documentation: `docs/openusd-industrial-library.md`.
